SELECT s.id, s.revision, s.latest_at, r.read_at FROM (
SELECT id, CONCAT(id, '|', created_at) revision, created_at latest_at FROM community_report WHERE state = 'OPEN'
SELECT id, CONCAT(id, '|', COALESCE(gmt_modified, gmt_create)) revision, COALESCE(gmt_modified, gmt_create) latest_at FROM feedback WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (official_reply IS NULL OR TRIM(official_reply) = '')
SELECT id, CONCAT(id, '|', COALESCE(gmt_modified, gmt_create)) revision, COALESCE(gmt_modified, gmt_create) latest_at FROM food_nutrition WHERE nutrition_source = 'AI_ESTIMATE' AND shelf_status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT g.id, CONCAT(g.id, '|', g.glucose_value, '|', g.recorded_at, '|', h.id) revision, g.gmt_modified latest_at FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id = g.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1 JOIN gp_glucose_alert_case h ON h.id = ( SELECT h2.id FROM gp_glucose_alert_case h2 WHERE h2.record_id = g.id ORDER BY h2.handled_at DESC, h2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE g.is_deleted = 0 AND (h.glucose_value <> g.glucose_value OR h.recorded_at <> g.recorded_at)
SELECT id, '' revision, created_at latest_at FROM community_report WHERE 1 = 0
) s LEFT JOIN admin_work_reminder_read r ON r.ops_id = #{opsId} AND r.kind = #{kind} AND r.source_id = s.id AND r.revision = s.revision ORDER BY s.id
